name: background-cubes-grid

frames.best_why: Broad orange wave rings sweep across the lit cube grid while the heading stays readable.

tagline: Glowing orange waves ripple across a tilted grid of 3D cubes under the cursor.
summary: A full-bleed three.js background of a tilted grid of cubes. Moving the pointer sends glowing orange waves rippling across the surface, which settles flat and then drops idle ripples on its own.
appearance: A dark full-bleed field of small rounded cubes in a receding perspective grid, catching warm orange light on raised crests while the rest stays near-black. A white heading and a small badge sit over it.
behaviour: Moving the cursor pushes a ripple through the cubes; a ring of raised, orange-lit blocks spreads out, passes on, and the surface settles flat. After a quiet moment it starts dropping its own random ripples.
demo_content: Badge Realtime infrastructure, headline Every event, felt across the grid, and a line about 1,936 live nodes.
use_when: A hero or landing page wants an interactive tech backdrop that responds to the pointer without taking over.
avoid_when: It is a heavy WebGL scene running every frame and has no touch hover, so it is a poor fit for low-end mobile.
customise: Variant, grid size, gap, base, wave and background colours, glow, amplitude, tilt and idle ripples are props. The demo headline and badge are separate, not part of the effect.
weight_why: A three.js instanced cube scene with post-processing renders every frame while waves move.

a11y.note: Marked aria-hidden and decorative, and idle ripples switch off under reduced motion, but pointer ripples still animate.

issues: The white heading overlaps the brightest orange crests, which lowers contrast in some frames.
Idle ripples keep the scene animating indefinitely, so the renderer never fully sleeps.
polish_why: Striking, well-tuned wave physics and glow; the headline text fights the brightest crests.
title: Background Cubes Grid
